name: Shinjou Rui
source:
Though her public appearance is that of a part-timer working as a teacher, her true profession is solving paranormal phenomena using ancient techniques-- that is, an exorcist. She was hired to examine the school after a certain person told her about a nest of parasitic creatures that have infested it.

She has a silent and cool personality, and only ever talks when it's necessary.
